@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock
+
+from ansible.executor.task_queue_manager import DisplaySend, FinalQueue
+from ansible.plugins import strategy
+from ansible.utils.display import Display
+
+
+def test_final_queue_preserves_display_method():
+    queue = MagicMock()
+
+    FinalQueue.send_display(queue, 'warning', 'message', formatted=True)
+
+    result = queue.put.call_args.args[0]
+    assert isinstance(result, DisplaySend)
+    assert result.method == 'warning'
+    assert result.args == ('message',)
+    assert result.kwargs == {'formatted': True}
+
+
+def test_results_thread_dispatches_display_method_and_deduplicates(monkeypatch):
+    display = Display()
+    output = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(display, 'display', output)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(display, '_warns', {})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(display, '_deprecations', {})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(display, '_final_q', None)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(strategy, 'display', display)
+
+    worker_queue = MagicMock()
+    worker_queue.get.side_effect = [
+        DisplaySend('warning', 'repeated'),
+        DisplaySend('warning', 'repeated'),
+        DisplaySend('deprecated', 'repeated', version='2.18'),
+        DisplaySend('deprecated', 'repeated', version='2.18'),
+        strategy.StrategySentinel(),
+    ]
+    worker = MagicMock(_final_q=worker_queue)
+
+    strategy.results_thread_main(worker)
+
+    assert output.call_count == 2
